label: Sky / Celestial
description: The sky as the hero subject (Civitai 'astronomy' category) — atmospheric optics and storm structure with the physics visible. Night-bound phenomena declare requires: night.

items.name: aurora-curtains
items.text: aurora curtains rippling green and violet over silhouetted peaks, rays combed straight down the magnetic field lines, the lower edges drawn sharpest

items.name: milky-way-core
items.text: the Milky Way core arching overhead in a moonless sky, dark dust lanes splitting the dense star fields, the galactic bulge glowing warm above the horizon

items.name: supercell
items.text: a rotating supercell stacked like an inverted wedding cake, mesocyclone striations wound tight around the barrel, a green-lit rain core hanging off its flank

items.name: mammatus
items.text: mammatus pouches sagging beneath a storm anvil after the worst has passed, each lobe a pocket of sinking cooled air, the edges lit like hammered metal

items.name: crepuscular-rays
items.text: crepuscular rays fanning from behind a broken cloud deck, parallel shafts that only seem to converge, haze making the light itself the subject

items.name: moonrise-full
items.text: a huge full moon rising through horizon haze, squashed and amber by the long slant of air, stealing scale from everything beneath it

items.name: comet
items.text: a naked-eye comet over quiet hills, its white dust tail curving along the orbit while the straight blue ion tail points dead away from the sun

items.name: lenticular-stack
items.text: a stack of lens-smooth lenticular clouds parked over a summit, motionless in a gale — the standing mountain wave rebuilding each disc as fast as the wind tears it away

items.name: star-trails
items.text: concentric star trails circling the celestial pole through an hours-long exposure, each arc carrying the true color of its star

items.name: noctilucent
items.text: electric-blue noctilucent clouds rippling at the edge of space — ice on meteor dust eighty kilometers up, shining only in midsummer twilight after the ground has gone dark

items.name: rainbow-full
items.text: a full double rainbow grounded in rain-washed light, the outer bow's colors reversed, the sky noticeably darker in the band between the two

items.name: eclipse-corona
items.text: a total solar eclipse at mid-totality, the corona feathering out along magnetic field lines around the black disc, the horizon ringed in 360 degrees of twilight color

items.name: light-pillar
items.text: a light pillar standing vertical above the low sun, built from millions of falling plate-shaped ice crystals

items.name: ice-halo
items.text: a full 22-degree halo ringing the sun through a cirrostratus veil, bright sundogs flanking it left and right

items.name: fogbow
items.text: a white fogbow arched over a thinning fog bank, colorless because its droplets are too small to split the light, a faint glory haloing the viewer's shadow at its center
